title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Stopping the command on its first round produced two opposite answers in the same sentence, and the test written for that case passed on it.

highlights.title: A report that no longer contradicts itself
highlights.description: Stopping on the first round said `Nothing unused left to remove. Stopped on request: run it again to finish.` When nothing was removed, the reason IS the answer and there is no headline to put in front of it.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The final sentence of Remove Everything Unused is built as one thing, with six cases pinned, instead of a headline glued to a note.
The test written for the cancelled case looked only for the second half of the sentence. It states what the sentence must not contain too.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A round was profiled rather than guessed: dead islands take 8.7 s of the 20, because the detector re-runs the symbol and member analyses inside itself.

Interleaved against the version from before the extent work, that cost measures 8.87 s against 8.82 s: it is not a regression, and sharing the work would mean opening the two most delicate detectors for a quarter of one round.
